channel.title: Tangent Tech Blog
channel.description: Engineering notes from the Tangent team.

item.title: Migrating a Monolith to Services Without a Rewrite
item.description: We spent six months moving our Rails monolith to independently deployable services by using the strangler-fig pattern on a single bounded context at a time, keeping the existing API surface unchanged throughout the migration.

item.title: How We Reduced Build Times by 60% with Remote Caching
item.description: By sharing a Bazel remote cache across all CI runners, we cut median build time from 8 minutes to under 3 minutes without changing any build targets or source files.

item.title: A Practical Guide to Structured Logging in Python
item.description: Switching from unstructured print statements to structlog with JSON output made log aggregation and alerting dramatically easier, and required changing fewer than twenty lines per service.

item.title: Postgres JSONB vs. Dedicated Document Store: A Measured Comparison
item.description: Under our read-heavy workload, Postgres JSONB with a GIN index matched the query throughput of a dedicated document store while eliminating the operational burden of running a second database.

item.title: Writing Runbooks That Engineers Actually Read
item.description: Keeping runbooks short, test-driven, and co-located with the service code reduced our mean time to recovery by 35% over the following quarter.
